name: assa-smart-fisheries-system-mvp
description: Runnable MVP for ASSA Smart Fisheries Monitoring and Digital Fish Market System.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix fisher-app && npm install --prefix admin-dashboard && npm install --prefix marketplace
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n backend,admin,fisher,market -c blue,magenta,green,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix admin-dashboard" "npm run dev --prefix fisher-app" "npm run dev --prefix marketplace"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix admin-dashboard && npm run build --prefix fisher-app && npm run build --prefix marketplace
